medicalFeature.title: Integrated medical counseling
medicalFeature.excerpt: Discuss symptoms, screenings, vaccines, medications, or lifestyle—not only with the doctor, but with our nursing team documenting your wishes for every visit.

medicalFeature.title: Board-certified physicians
medicalFeature.excerpt: Internists and family doctors supported by fellows in cardiology, endocrinology, and mental health—with digital charting accessible after each encounter.

medicalFeature.title: On-site diagnostics
medicalFeature.excerpt: Point-of-care testing, weekday lab draws until 17:30, courier drops to tertiary labs, plus electronic results delivered securely to patients.

medicalFeature.title: Urgent liaison
medicalFeature.excerpt: After-hours answering service directs emergencies to EMS and stabilizes callers; daytime triage frees capacity for genuinely urgent walk-ins.

medicalFeature.title: Dedicated care coordinators
medicalFeature.excerpt: Navigators chase imaging authorizations, prior authorizations, and specialist summaries so you rarely wait on paperwork between appointments.

medicalFeature.title: Patient-centered follow-up
medicalFeature.excerpt: Reminder texts, pharmacist consults when starting new meds, nurse callbacks after procedures, plus remote blood-pressure monitoring enrolment.

team.name: Dr. Robert David, MBBS
